original_title: Don't worry, GTA 6 is still planned for November, marketing push will begin this summer
summary_en: I know, I know, whenever you see a GTA headline at the moment, you're expecting a new trailer, right? There is currently a huge swathe of the internet obsessed with the idea we're going to get GTA 6 retail price and its third trailer any day now. And you know what? It seems, maybe, there's some fire behind all that smoke.
